name: Step-Two Cover-Recursive Obstructions
definition: On coordinates $\mathbb Z_n$, call a nonempty set short when it has at most three elements contained in a cyclic arc of length four. Call it long when, for some $a$, it contains $\{a,a+2,a+4\}$, is contained in $[a,a+5)$, and has at most four elements. Then $\mathcal F_n$ consists of the empty set and all short or long sets.
parameters: $n\ge9$ odd. The family has $10n+1$ vertices, isometric dimension $n$, and VC dimension three.
recognition: Each coordinate has a one-sided defect of three vertices inducing a path. Elementary minors admit recursive peripheral decompositions that advance through the remaining cyclic coordinates in steps of two; oddness makes this traversal exhaustive.
comments: Every member is an ample pc-minimal obstruction to the cover-recursively peripheral class and is not an antipodally punctured cube.
